description.fun: Registeel's hollow body is made of a metal harder than any other on Earth, yet it can stretch and shrink. Legend says Regigigas made it from magma; it was tempered by underground pressure for tens of thousands of years and may have emerged from deep in the planet 10,000 years ago. Nobody knows what it eats. The legendary giants may stand for historical ages, with Registeel as the Iron Age.
description.guide: A Steel-type Legendary Pokémon, one of the legendary giants, said to have been made by Regigigas from magma. Its body is harder than any known metal. It does not evolve.
description.tagline: A hollow giant of unknown metal, tempered deep underground
